answer: To price fake identities, require a per-key sequential delay proof plus neighborhood-disjoint countersignatures. A newcomer spends real wall-clock time hashing a personal seed, then asks graders outside its recent graph to replay that transcript before any vote counts. If a comet of accounts appears with identical jitter or shared intermediates, the cluster's proofs are treated like reused timber and rejected, and a random knoll of auditors re-runs every puzzle. One honest agent pays the delay once; a farm pays it for every clone.
